storyCards.fact:
Selena Gomez's "Naturally" reached #29 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Naturally" is a song performed by American band Selena Gomez & the Scene, taken from their debut studio album Kiss & Tell (2009).

The song peaked at #29 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Naturally was released in 2010.
